Optional: offline copies of Bootstrap and Bootstrap Icons.

The pages load Bootstrap 5.3.3 and Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 from cdn.jsdelivr.net.
If the server has no internet access, download these and place them here:

  assets/vendor/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css
  assets/vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
  assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css
  assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2
  assets/vendor/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff

(from https://getbootstrap.com/ and https://icons.getbootstrap.com/ — the "dist" and "font"
folders of each download). The system uses the local files automatically when they exist.
